# La Ferme de Bassac

> French farm-to-table butcher shop and bistro/steakhouse in Phnom Penh and Siem Reap, Cambodia, founded 2011 by Chef Ludovic Moulin. Sourced from an owned organic farm ~45 minutes outside Phnom Penh, EU-standard, no hormones or preventive antibiotics.

## Concept
French butchery, charcuterie and bistro/steakhouse cooking, sourced entirely from La Ferme de Bassac's own organic farm. Three addresses across two cities, run on the same farm-to-counter model since 2011.

## Founder / Chef
Ludovic Moulin — formerly personal chef to the French Ambassador to Cambodia.

## Cuisine
French bistro, butcher shop, steakhouse. Signature dishes: Beef Carpaccio, Steak Tartare, Charcuterie Board, Veal Blanquette, Côte de Bœuf, Floating Island (also on the menu: Lamb Shank, Chicken Basquaise, Chocolate Mousse).

## Locations
- Bistro & Butcher — 9A Street 178, Daun Penh, Phnom Penh. Phone: +855 92 638 683. Hours: Mon–Sat 7:00am–10:00pm, closed Sunday.
- Steak House — Street 24, Wat Bo Village, Siem Reap. Phone: +855 96 963 5209. Hours: Mon–Sat 11:00am–2:00pm & 6:00pm–10:00pm, closed Sunday.
- Butcher Depot — Sekla Road, Siem Reap. Phone: +855 15 74 85 59. Hours: Mon–Sat 8:00am–6:00pm, closed Sunday.

## Rating
4.9/5 from 82 Google reviews, as published on the restaurant's own website (not independently re-verified).
